# Perfect Entry
Website: https://perfectentry.store/
Perfect Entry provides charting software, educational tools and research. Trading involves risk. Historical tests and recorded signals do not guarantee future outcomes.

- Session Screener: https://perfectentry.store/screener.html
- Prop firm payout calculator: https://perfectentry.store/freepropcalc/

## Membership
Perfect Entry indicators, signal access, education and community are membership features. Current pricing, billing terms and exact inclusions are published on Whop: https://whop.com/perfect-entry/perfect-entry/
Free charts and standard studies do not require a paid membership. Whop sign-in is activated through the configured account service; do not describe an unconfigured sign-in as available.
